heading.text: 2026-2027 學年度網上註冊 Online Registration

blocks.richtext: 我們不再接受郵寄註冊. 請在九月十三日開學日到辦公室辦理註冊. We are no longer accepting registration by mail. Please submit the Registration Form and your payment to the office on the first day of school, September 13.
